card.name: Small words before risk findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of' and 'in' in risk and warning passages, often just before a trial name like WHI or a risk statement. Common in estrogen and diabetes drug labels.

modes.label: Before trial name
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' right before the Women's Health Initiative study name in hormone therapy text.
modes.example: Coronary Heart Disease In<< the>> WHI estrogen-alone substudy, no

modes.label: Before risk statement
modes.description: 'of' or 'in' leading into a stated risk or incidence in a warning.
modes.example: Age 65 or Greater The risk<< of>> metformin-associated lactic acidosis

modes.label: Before comparison number
modes.description: The space after 'versus' before a case count.
modes.example: the absolute risk was 46 versus<< >>25 cases per 10,

card.writes: It pushes toward fracture and hip words, as in bone fracture risk, and away from family terms like grandchildren.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in warnings where a bone fracture risk may be named next.
